Trippie Redd talked about the situation on his Instagram Live.

column6: "MANSION MUSIK" is Trippie Redd's 9th album released to streaming platforms, with the album being first announced by Trippie in October 2022, in a now-deleted Instagram post. He then previewed several snippets and claimed that they were meant for his 10th album "A Love Letter To You 5". Trippie went on Instagram live a few months later to reveal that this album would be the first of two back-to-back projects. On January 12, 2023, Trippie posted in a now-deleted Instagram story a partial tracklist for the album, alongside revealing half of the projects original cover art. That same day, Trippie took to Twitter denying that the cover shown was the album’s cover art after it was leaked online alongside ten tracks off the album.
